description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of data sources within a combined training set. The chart contains ten slices, each representing a different data source. The slices are labeled NQ (blue, 31.3%), SCIFACT (teal, 0.1%), ENTFA (orange, 1.8%), FACTCC (red, 2.6%), ANLI (yellow, 4.6%), FEVER (coral, 16.1%), MULTINLI (pink, 11.3%), MULTIFC (light pink, 0.5%), PUBHEALTH (dark green, 1.2%), SNLI (light blue, 15.4%), and VITAMINC (grey, 13.0%), and XSUMHUL (purple, 1.6%). Percentage labels are displayed directly within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered clockwise, generally from largest to smallest proportion, though this is not strictly maintained. A legend is provided alongside the chart, listing each data source and its corresponding color.
